COMPUTER STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.

3. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

5. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

8. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.

9. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

10. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.

11. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

15. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
